title: Plan
description: plans/{planId}.json in R2 PRIVATE — §52, §53, Etapa 8b. SuperAdmin-managed plan catalog entry. No public projection exists for this object (§53 'gerenciar planos' is an admin-only concern in this lot; billing/Asaas is Etapa 10).

maxGalleryItems.description: Replaces the old PROVISIONAL_MAX_GALLERY_ITEMS fixed constant (business/listings.js, Etapa 5) — the per-listing gallery photo cap enforced for every broker on this plan.
